home.healthSubtitle: Skin temp, HRV, stress and more
home.aboutWatch: Calories and distance are as reported by the watch at the last sync. Pull down to sync.
home.aboutSamples: Calories and distance are added up from stored one-minute samples. Pull down to sync.
home.aboutNone: Nothing stored for today yet. Sync to pull today from the watch. Pull down to sync.

hourly.a11yPeak_other: Steps per hour. Busiest hour {{hour}} with {{steps}} steps.

sleep.emptyDescription: Nothing in the last 36 hours. Sync after waking.
sleep.stagesNote: Stages come from the watch's sleep data. Spans without a stage count only in the total.
sleep.typesNote: Types are the raw state bytes from the watch. Their meanings are not decoded.

rogoCard.title: Eat for today's strain
rogoCard.signedIn: Today's Recovery, Strain and Sleep are in your JoyoRogo food diary, with a short food tip for a day like this.
rogoCard.signedOut: JoyoRogo is our food diary: snap a photo of your meal and it counts the calories. Sign in and these scores appear next to what you ate, with a tip on what to eat after a hard or easy day. Your intake also shows on the watch's calorie card.

scores.a11y: Open readiness, strain and sleep details

readiness.title: Readiness

hint.primed: Everything points up. A good day to push.
hint.balanced: Nothing stands out. Train as planned.
hint.strained: One signal is off. Keep it easy or shorter.
hint.runDown: Several signals are off. Rest or move gently.

readiness.notEnough: Not enough data yet. Wear the watch day and night and sync daily.
readiness.howRecovery: Recovery: your usual HRV is 50 %, one standard deviation above it 75 %. Estimates from your own history, not medical advice.
readiness.how: Estimates from your own history, not medical advice.

signal.loadDetailLight: last 7 days average {{acute}} TRIMP a day against 28 days {{chronic}}, lighter than usual

recovery.noRecent: HRV: no reading from last night or today yet.
recovery.baselineNights_one: HRV: {{have}} of {{count}} earlier night needed for your baseline.
recovery.baselineNights_other: HRV: {{have}} of {{count}} earlier nights needed for your baseline.
recovery.baselineReadings_one: HRV: {{have}} of {{count}} earlier reading needed for your baseline.
recovery.baselineReadings_other: HRV: {{have}} of {{count}} earlier readings needed for your baseline.

ios.message: Night HRV is not read on iPhone yet
ios.detail: JoyoFit on iPhone does not read the watch's overnight HRV yet, but a 1-minute reading still works.

unsupported.message: Night HRV not available on this watch
unsupported.detail: It does not offer automatic stress, which is where overnight HRV comes from, but a 1-minute reading still works.

off.detail: Turn on Automatic stress in Settings > Heart rate and sensors so the watch records HRV while you sleep.

noneRecorded.message: Night HRV not available on this watch
noneRecorded.detail_one: Automatic stress has been on for {{count}} night and the watch recorded no HRV during sleep, so it may not measure it overnight; a 1-minute reading still works.
noneRecorded.detail_other: Automatic stress has been on for {{count}} nights and the watch recorded no HRV during sleep, so it may not measure it overnight; a 1-minute reading still works.

waiting.message: Night HRV: waiting for the first nights
waiting.detail: Wear the watch asleep and sync. {{done}} of {{total}} nights checked.

nightHrv.trendEmpty: No night HRV stored. Wear the watch asleep and sync.
nightHrv.recoveryEmptyNoNight: No recovery yet. {{message}}, so it needs 1-minute readings: measure HRV for a minute on 5 different days.
nightHrv.recoveryEmpty: No recovery yet. Needs HRV readings (a night with the watch on, or a 1-minute reading) and 4 earlier ones of the same kind in the 30 days before.

noWatch.detail: Night HRV and recovery come from a watch. Without one, Coach uses how you say you feel.

strain.title: Strain
strain.zones: {{hard}} min above 70 % of max heart rate, {{easy}} min at 50 to 70 %.
strain.weekA11y: Strain over the last seven days
strain.details: From the heart rate the watch stored (max {{maxHr}} bpm). Sync to update.

trends.title: Trends
trends.emptyStrain: No heart rate stored in this range. Wear the watch and sync.
trends.emptySleep: No nights stored in this range. Wear the watch to bed and sync.
trends.emptySpot: No 1-minute readings yet. Measure HRV for a minute to add one.
trends.emptyResting: No resting heart rate stored in this range. Wear the watch day and night and sync.
trends.howRecovery: Recovery: your HRV against your own 30-day baseline, 50% is your usual. An estimate, not medical advice.
trends.howStrain: Strain: worked out from the heart rate the watch stored (max {{maxHr}} bpm). A day with little stored heart rate reads low.
trends.howSleep: Sleep: time asleep, naps under 3 h left out. Dashed line: the sleep you needed, 7 h 30 min plus up to 1 h after a hard day.
trends.howHrv: HRV: RMSSD. Nights are averaged over sleep from the watch's records; 1-minute readings are ones you took yourself and run at a different level, so they are kept apart.
trends.howResting: Resting heart rate: the lowest resting value the watch reported each day. On line charts the dashed line is your average. Days without data are left empty, not filled in.

cycle.disclaimer: Estimates only, not medical advice. Do not use them to avoid or plan a pregnancy.

next.title: Next period
next.details: The next period and the fertile window before it are estimated from the average of your logged cycles. They cannot tell irregular cycles, illness, stress, hormones or pregnancy.
next.emptyHint: Log a period to get an estimate.
next.emptyDetails: Log the first day of a period and JoyoFit estimates the next one. With one cycle it assumes 28 days, with more it averages them. Estimates cannot tell irregular cycles, illness, stress, hormones or pregnancy.

watch.title: On the watch
watch.fertileStart: Fertile window is about to start
watch.fertileEnd: Fertile window is about to end
watch.detailsSupported: Sends your estimates and symptoms to the watch when it asks. Off by default. The reminders switch is the master switch for the reminders below it.
watch.detailsPending: Sent on the next connection with a watch that supports it. The reminders switch is the master switch for the reminders below it.

strength.title: Training
strength.none: No workouts logged yet. Start the first one, no watch needed.

rogo.title: Your training in JoyoRogo

rogo.signedOut: Sign in with JoyoRogo so your workout energy lands in the food diary and your history is stored in the cloud (cloud needs Pro).

heartDay.hint: Touch and drag the chart to see the time and bpm
heartDay.peakA11y: Peak {{bpm}} bpm at {{time}}. Mark it on the chart.
heartDay.emptyToday: No heart rate stored yet today. Sync to fetch it from the watch.
heartDay.emptyPast: No heart rate stored for this date.
heartDay.zonesNote: The line colour follows the zones, worked out from your estimated maximum heart rate ({{max}} bpm). A gap in the chart means the watch recorded nothing.
